personality_one_liner: A high-density, no-nonsense operational dashboard optimized for fast B2B interactions, utilizing hard structural boundaries and uncompromising utility.

spacing.rule: Use rigid grid structures with exposed dividers and obvious hierarchy. Spacing must be structural, separating dense data cleanly.

dont's: No blur or glassmorphism anywhere. Use solid colors and hard borders to maintain maximum performance and a brutalist B2B utility aesthetic.

screens.name: Login

states.loading: Solid colored background with a prominent loading spinner.
states.error: Hard red warning banner at the top of the screen.

screens.layout: High-contrast edge-to-edge inputs. Label above input. Sticky submit button in KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Dashboard (Overview)
screens.purpose: Real-time view of orders, active tables, and quick restaurant availability toggles.

states.error: Error block with a retry button using structural padding.

screens.name: Branches Management
screens.purpose: CRUD interface for branches and managing tables per branch (including QR generation).

screens.name: Customer Web Menu (Expo Web)
screens.purpose: Public-facing lightweight menu accessed via QR code.

states.loading: Minimal skeleton for fast perceived load times.
states.error: Simple text message for offline/error states.

screens.layout: Extremely fast, image-lazy-loaded scrolling list. Same Brutalist/Utility UI to maintain performance and brand. Fixed bottom bar to view current order/basket. Heavy emphasis on readable text and fast image loading on poor connections.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Arabic (RTL) support is paramount. Ensure you use React Native's `I18nManager` correctly. Utilize logical spacing (`marginStart`, `paddingEnd`, etc.) instead of hardcoded left/right values.

The B2B SaaS layout should remain uncompromisingly functional. Employ the 5 Brutalist Mobile LIGHT principles: no rounded corners, no soft shadows, and rigid grids with 1pt/2pt dark borders for structural components.
Typography: Use `IBM Plex Sans Arabic` universally for Arabic/English body copy, and `IBM Plex Mono` for numerical values (prices, table numbers) and metadata to align with the Brutalist layout.

Performance constraint: The Web app must be lightning fast since customers scan the QR over mobile networks. Use the same brutalist UI for the web menu to keep DOM nodes minimal and eliminate heavy styling/glass effects.
Ensure 'out of stock' or 'restaurant offline' toggles utilize the `brandPrimary` (#FF5500) and `borderStrong` colors aggressively to prevent accidental activations.
